detail.longDescription: ChatGPT is the biggest name in AI chatbots, but it's far from the only one around. And depending on what you're trying to do, it might not even be the best option for you. ChatGPT is a great general-purpose chatbot, but like most jacks-of-all-trades, it can lose out to more specific tools for certain jobs.
